Subject: Advance invoice held — VAT ID confirmation needed

Hi Rishi,

We were about to release the 50% prepayment for the platform subscription (PO #4521) but our AP team put the wire on hold because the invoice shows VAT charged. We need one of the following before payment: a) a valid EU VAT number for Redwood (so we can reverse-charge), or b) a reissued invoice showing net (reverse-charge) treatment.

I've attached the signed PO for reference. Can you confirm your VAT registration number and whether you can reissue the invoice without VAT? We need to clear this by Monday to keep our go-live timeline.

Attachments: Signed_Purchase_Order_4521.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks,
Oliver Hayes
Head of Procurement — Greenridge Logistics
oliver.hayes@greenridge.com
+44 20 7946 0123

On a related note, our tax team will also want a copy of the VAT certificate for their records once you confirm the treatment.

Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and the PO.

Summary / next steps from our side:
- I'll run a quick VAT ID validation against the EU VIES and our finance system.
- If the VAT ID validates and reverse-charge applies, Sales Ops will reissue the invoice net (no VAT) and include a note: "Reverse-charge — Article 196 VAT Directive / UK VAT reverse charge where applicable."
- If we cannot validate, I'll escalate to Finance to provide an exemption or a corrected invoice.

Ben / Vanessa — can one of you take ownership of reissuing the invoice (RI-4521) if Rishi's validation is green? Ben, please prepare a net reissue template with the PO reference and a short tax note; Vanessa, loop in Billing ops for the actual reissue and mark for expedited handling.

Oliver — would you be able to share the AP contact and any internal ID they need on the invoice? If you can also accept DocuSign for the confirmation, I can route the paperwork faster.

Rishi
